asked: Feature 434's SC-003 says a stage's recorded count EQUALS make perf-fanout's for the reference spec, same seed and engine. Measured 2026-10-27 on seed 39 at 40 households: make phase-calls (each stage in a fresh process, the stages before it run plainly, exactly as the fanout's jobs) matches the fanout on 19 of 23 stages; field -307, sink -52, seat +465, homesteads +298 (largest relative 0.23%, seat). The fanout does not reproduce itself to that precision: two consecutive fanout runs on the same engine gave sink 77,448 then 77,396; seat was 205,378 in a fanout from a HEAD worktree this morning and 204,913 in the clone (phase-calls reads 205,378); five homesteads-only fanouts gave 5,205,033-5,205,034. So exact equality cannot be met by the fanout against itself. Should SC-003 be accepted as met within the fanout's own run-to-run variation (every stage within the larger of 0.25% and the fanout's own spread), recorded with these measurements, or must the spec change (a round past its fifth)?
why: Two of the four differing stages match a fanout run exactly (sink 77,396 is the second fanout's, seat 205,378 the HEAD-worktree fanout's), so their deltas are the fanout's own run and environment variation; the other two carry a small residue the fanout's noise does not explain (homesteads +298 against six fanouts spanning 5,205,031-5,205,034; field -307 with no repeat data), so this is not 'within the fanout's spread' but a residue too small to matter. No consumer of the count moves: the page's shares round to 0.1% and no stage's share changes, the feature-427 call-count check watches 5% a stage and 2% of the total, and the GM's request says outright he is not asking for exact numbers. Another spec round to restate an equality the fanout cannot meet against itself would buy nothing.
what: SC-003 stands as met for the reference spec at seed 39, 40 households, on this engine, by waiver: the session puts a note beside SC-003 in spec.md (no spec-fidelity round is owed for the note, and SC-003's text is not rewritten) citing ask:434-SC-003-exact and the measured deltas - field -307, sink -52, seat +465, homesteads +298, the other 19 stages equal - saying sink and seat each equal one fanout run exactly and field and homesteads keep a residue of a few hundred calls (at most 0.006% of the stage for homesteads, 0.011% for field). Do NOT write a tolerance such as 0.25% into the spec or a test: that figure exists only to cover the largest delta seen, and a number set that way becomes one the next session defends. FR-006 is met as: the same cProfile call measure, each stage in the fanout job's process state, the residue stated. No gate test compares phase-calls against the fanout (it is a minute-plus run; the spec already keeps the tally on demand). The waiver is bound to residues at this scale: a later phase-calls that differs from the fanout by thousands of calls in a stage, or by more than a few hundred where the fanout repeats itself to within a handful, is a new question. The session goes on to the feature's remaining tasks.
